payload.prompt: Topkapi Palace after the Ottoman conquest of Constantinople, layered courtyards, imperial gate, treasury halls, Bosporus and Golden Horn, conquest entry procession with banners, historically grounded world wonder key art, cinematic palace panorama, ultra-detailed, no modern elements.

revised_prompt: Create a historically grounded cinematic key art panorama of Topkapi Palace shortly after the Ottoman conquest of Constantinople. Wide composition in 1536x1024 aspect ratio. Show the layered courtyards of the early palace complex, the imperial gate, treasury halls, and the dramatic surrounding views of the Bosporus and Golden Horn. Include a conquest entry procession with Ottoman banners, mounted figures, attendants, and ceremonial movement entering the palace grounds. Architecture and costume must be authentic to the late 15th century Ottoman world, richly detailed, majestic, and epic like a world wonder illustration. Ultra-detailed textures, atmospheric light, sweeping panoramic perspective, no modern elements, no anachronisms, no contemporary cityscape, no electrical lines, no modern ships.
